x-fc-supplement.title: Connecting numbers by API in accounts: a number by QR, its QR code, connect links, and the numbers list by reference
x-fc-supplement.source: accounts tag v1.5.97 @ 558332bcf1ffdb8e064fd3a1f7fafc67c4f95e8d (the one running in production on 2026-11-04), read only with git show
x-fc-supplement.portal: developers-portal main @ f7045dc, snapshots/accounts/openapi.json (accounts 4e11bbb6a, 2026-10-26): same operationIds (deviceProvisioning.*, connectLink.*), tags and permissions
x-fc-supplement.edge: api-edge main @ 975d815 (deployed to production on 2026-10-25): /api/v1/connect-links goes to accounts. The latest tag, v0.3.0, does not route it yet
x-fc-supplement.reason: The portal's unified specification (13-10 snapshot) predates connecting numbers by API (accounts, 25-10). The six routes are new; GET /api/v1/devices is replaced (same operationId) to add its external_reference filter. When the portal publishes a unified specification that has them, remove this supplement from the config.
x-fc-supplement.key_access: In allowed of config/platform-gate.php. POST /devices, GET /devices/{device}/qr, POST /connect-links and DELETE /connect-links/{link} need accounts:operate (they give control of a WhatsApp number; they are not irreversible), the other GETs accounts:read. Creating needs a key of the account owner and a place in the plan.

tags.name: DeviceProvisioning
tags.description: Create a number that connects by scanning a QR code, and read its QR.

tags.name: ConnectLink
tags.description: Single-use links for your customer to connect a WhatsApp number to your account from a Funnelchat page.

parameters.name: external_reference
parameters.description: Only the numbers with exactly this reference: yours, given when creating the number or the connect link.

200.description: The numbers, paginated, by ascending id.

get.x-fc-purpose: Lists your WhatsApp numbers with their provider, whether they are connected (connected) and active, and their health, and gets the IDs the other operations use. External Reference finds the number a connect link created.

post.summary: Create a number to connect by QR

connection.description: How the number connects. Only qr: an official number is connected with a connect link of type meta.

external_reference.description: Your own reference for this number (for example, your customer's ID). Not unique. It comes back in the number and in the device.* events.

same_number_as.description: ID of a number of the account connected to the official API in coexistence: the QR connection is added to that same number and takes no new place in the plan.

country.description: Country the WhatsApp session is opened from, two letters (for example mx): the country of the phone that will scan the QR. Without it, co (Colombia).

201.description: The number created, not connected yet.

post.x-fc-purpose: Creates a number of the account that connects by scanning a QR code with the WhatsApp app. Then read its QR with "Get a number's QR code", or send your customer a connect link instead.

qr_code.description: A PNG image as a data URI (data:image/png;base64,...), or null while the session starts and once connected.

get.x-fc-purpose: Gets the QR code that connects a QR number: scan it with the WhatsApp app (Linked devices). Once connected, connected is true and the device.connected event arrives.

type.description: qr: a number connected by scanning a QR code. meta: an official number, with Meta's Embedded Signup.

allowed_connection_types.description: Only with type meta, and required there: coexistence keeps the number in the WhatsApp Business app; dedicated is a number only for the API.

provision_us_number.description: Only with type meta: also offer a US number of Funnelchat's pool (always dedicated).

device_id.description: Reconnect this number of the account instead of adding one (it takes no new place).

same_number_as.description: Only with type qr: add QR to this number of the account in coexistence.

country.description: Only with type qr and without Number ID: country the WhatsApp session is opened from, two letters (the country of your customer's phone).

external_reference.description: Your own reference: it is copied to the number the link creates and comes in device.connected.

return_url.description: https address the page sends your customer to at the end, with the result in the query string (connect_link_id, status, and device_id or error_code).

expires_in_minutes.description: How long the link lives: 30 to 10080 minutes (7 days); 1440 (24 hours) by default.

201.description: The link created. Its url appears only in this response.

post.x-fc-purpose: Creates a single-use link for your customer to connect a WhatsApp number to your account from a Funnelchat page, without the panel: send them the url of the response.

parameters.name: external_reference
parameters.description: Only the links with exactly this reference.

200.description: The links, newest first, paginated, without their url.

get.x-fc-purpose: Lists the account's connect links, newest first and without their url, filtered by status or by your reference.
Gets a connect link's current status (pending, completed, failed, expired or revoked) and, once completed, the device_id of the number it connected.

delete.x-fc-purpose: Revokes a pending connect link: its page then answers that the link no longer works. If the page had already created a number that is not connected yet, that number is deleted.

SupDevice.description: A WhatsApp number of the account (DeviceResource). Only the fields the first use needs are listed; the API returns more.

number.description: The phone, empty until the number is connected for the first time.

connected.description: Whether the number is connected now.

url.description: The link to send your customer. Only in the response of Create a connect link: null everywhere else.

device_id.description: The number the link reconnects, or the one it connected once completed.
